script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - NIGHT

A cozy living room filled with warm light from the fireplace. JESSICA, a woman in her mid-thirties, sits on the couch, her eyes red from crying. The sound of raindrops against the window can be heard.

Suddenly, there's a knock on the door. Jessica hesitates but then gets up to answer it.

JESSICA (V.O.)
(whispering)
I'm not ready for this.

JESSICA opens the door, revealing MAX, a man in his early forties. He holds a bouquet of flowers.

MAX
(smiling)
I know we haven't spoken in years, but I couldn't let this anniversary go by without trying to make things right between us.

Jessica looks shocked, tears streaming down her face.

JESSICA
(angrily)
What right do you have to come here and expect me to forgive you? You left me when I needed you most!

Max steps inside, closing the door behind him.

MAX
(sincerely)
Jessica, I was a coward. I made a mistake. I've spent every day since then regretting my decision and wondering if there was any way I could make it right. I can't change the past, but I can try to make amends for my actions.

Jessica hesitates, her anger slowly fading away.

JESSICA
(softly)
What makes you think I even want to talk to you?

MAX
(looking her in the eyes)
Because I know deep down that you still care about me, just as I care about you. And I believe that if we can find a way to forgive each other, we can build a better future for ourselves.

Jessica pauses, considering his words.

JESSICA
(sighing)
Fine. We'll talk. But this is the only chance you'll get.

Max nods, setting the flowers on the coffee table.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

The two of them sit at the kitchen table, surrounded by the scent of freshly brewed coffee.

Jessica looks at Max, her expression still guarded.

JESSICA
(angrily)
Okay, so why did you leave me? Was it because of the miscarriage? Because I couldn't give you a child?

Max looks down, shame etched on his face.

MAX
(hesitantly)
Yes, it was the miscarriage. I couldn't bear the thought of raising a child in a household filled with so much pain and anger. I was afraid that I would only pass on my own fears and insecurities to our child. I was a coward, Jessica. I should have stayed and tried to work things out with you.

Jessica's expression softens as she listens to him.

JESSICA
(sighing)
I was hurting, too. But I didn't want to burden you with my emotions. I thought if I pushed you away, it would be easier for both of us. I was wrong.

Max reaches across the table and takes her hand in his.

MAX
(gently)
We both made mistakes, Jessica. But we can't change the past. We can only learn from it and move forward. Will you give me another chance?

Jessica looks at him, her eyes filled with emotion.

JESSICA
(sighing)
Yes, I'll give you another chance. But we have to work on rebuilding our relationship. It won't be easy, but I'm willing to try.

Max smiles, tears welling up in his eyes.

MAX
(gratefully)
Thank you, Jessica. I promise I won't let you down again.

INT. PARK - DAY

Jessica and Max sit on a park bench, watching their daughter, LUCY, play on the swings. The sun beats down on them, casting long shadows on the ground.

MAX
(smiling)
I never thought I'd get another chance at happiness, but being here with you and Lucy makes me realize that sometimes, forgiveness can lead to the most beautiful things in life.

Jessica looks at him, her eyes filled with love and gratitude.

JESSICA
(smiling)
Yes, it can. But it takes time and effort to heal old wounds. We can't just erase the past, but we can learn from it and build a better future for ourselves and our family.

Max nods, his hand resting on hers.

MAX
(seriously)
I'm ready to do whatever it takes to make things right between us, Jessica. I promise.

Jessica looks into his eyes, her heart swelling with love and forgiveness.

JESSICA
(softly)
I believe you, Max. And I'm ready to start over, too.

They share a gentle embrace, their hearts intertwined as they begin their journey towards forgiveness and healing.

FADE OUT.
